formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x2 x3 : ℕ),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x1 →       x2 < (26 : ℕ) + x1.size →         x3 < (26 : ℕ) + x1.size →           have x8 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))};           have x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → List Bool := fun (x9 x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => (List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x11 = x9)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x11 = x10);           have x10 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → List Bool := fun (x10 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => (List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x11 ∈ x10)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x12 ∈ x10, x12 - x11 ∉ x8);           have x11 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Prop := fun (x11 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) => x11.card = (4 : ℕ) ∧ ∀ (x12 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x13 ∈ x11 | x13 - x12 ∈ x8}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ);           have x12 : ℕ → List Bool → Bool := fun (x12 : ℕ) (x13 : List Bool) => (x1.wires x13).getD x12 Bool.false;           (∀ (x13 x14 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x13 - x14 ∈ x8 → x12 x2 (x9 x13 x14) = Bool.true ∧ x12 x3 (x9 x13 x14) = Bool.true) → (∀ (x14 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x11 x14 → x12 x2 (x10 x14) = Bool.false ∨ x12 x3 (x10 x14) = Bool.false) → (∃ (x15 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x11 x15 ∧ x12 x2 (x10 x15) = Bool.false ∧ x12 x3 (x10 x15) = Bool.true) → (∃ (x16 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x11 x16 ∧ x12 x3 (x10 x16) = Bool.false ∧ x12 x2 (x10 x16) = Bool.true) → (63 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
plain_statement: The plane of order 3 (13 points, 13 lines); a circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, each reading earlier wires, on the 26 inputs, and two of its wires. If both wires accept every incident point-line pair, every quadrangle input (four points, no three on a line, with every line missing them) is rejected by one wire or the other, and each wire rejects some quadrangle input the other accepts, then the circuit has at least 63 gates.
